scope: Transactional browse filters and season selection

temporaryLibraryFlowHarness.scope: Actual LibraryViewModel, MediaCardViewModel, MediaShelfViewModel, ImageCache, API and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm in a temporary net10.0 xUnit harness with only the WinUI Visibility enum stubbed. Synthetic HttpMessageHandler responses; no real Emby server or Windows UI was contacted.
cases: Pending filters retain Items, Subtitle and CollectionRevision; identical IDs commit without Reset and preserve card references
The latest filter wins when an older server response arrives after it
Failed filters restore public options and subsequent paging uses the committed query
Returning to committed options rejects an older pending result and preserves card references
Pending and failed season changes preserve episode and playback objects and restore the committed selected season
Successful season selection publishes CollectionRevision only after episodes, selected season and playback target are committed

Initial season loading disables season selection, ignores another-season selection without making a request, then enables selection after success; a later failed selection retains committed episodes and playback
Initial season failure restores selection availability and selecting another season successfully recovers
temporaryLibraryFlowHarness.warnings: Existing temporary tests emit xUnit1051 suggestions for calls using the default CancellationToken. The six transactional tests and two initial-season tests use the test cancellation token.

limitations: This receipt verifies managed ViewModel behavior only. It does not establish native XAML compilation, visual stability or scrollbar behavior.
